scripts.format: prettier --write .github/workflows/ci.yml src tests e2e index.html package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts eslint.config.js README.md "docs/*.md" "docs/experiments/*.md"
scripts.format:check: prettier --check .github/workflows/ci.yml src tests e2e index.html package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts eslint.config.js README.md "docs/*.md" "docs/experiments/*.md"
scripts.format:python: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run-python.ps1 -m ruff format python
scripts.format:python:check: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run-python.ps1 -m ruff format --check python
scripts.lint:python: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run-python.ps1 -m ruff check python
scripts.typecheck:python: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run-python.ps1 -m mypy python/src python/tests python/tools
